# orchestration_approve_tool

> Approve the current stage gate in a workflow execution.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `orchestration` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=orchestration_approve_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Approve the current stage gate in a workflow execution.
This advances the workflow to the next stage.

Call this when the user approves the output of the current stage
(e.g., "looks good", "approve", "proceed").

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orchestration_execution_id` | integer | yes | The workflow execution ID to approve. |
| `notes` | string | no | Optional approval notes or comments from the user. |
